playing_time.sim_note: SIMULATED: what-if replays of signals not taken (skipped, blocked, shadow) on the day's bars with backtest costs; no fill-realism checks, so optimistic. Never part of live trades, P/L or win rate.
playing_time.rules: silent: no signals when >= 3 were expected; crowded-out: >= 25% of signals (and >= 3) skipped because another setup held the symbol; starved: entries/day < 25% of the expected rate (>= 4 expected); slow: on track but below 15 entries/week (60 trades in 20 sessions); ok otherwise. Expected rates are lab rates without competition, so they are an upper reference. silent / starved need >= 3 live sessions ('watch' before that).
playing_time.note: Report only; it does not change which trades are taken. Educational only — not financial advice.
